children: NewHydrogen entered into an Equity Financing Agreement with GHS Investments for up to $3.0 million, providing the option to sell shares via puts once a Form S-1 becomes effective. Pricing is set at 92.5% of the lowest traded price over the prior 10 trading days, with a 4.99% ownership cap and $10,000–$1,000,000 per put limits. The company issued 980,713 commitment shares at signing. In a related Registration Rights Agreement, NewHydrogen committed to file an S-1 within 30 days and pursue effectiveness within 30 days of filing, but no later than 90 days, to enable use of the facility and register resales.
